limitations: Repeated regression corpus, not blind testing
Automatic pairing does not prove identical editions
Slide comparison requires exact source and destination bars; unaligned events are not counted as correct
Only same-system parallel chords with unchanged string set, equal nonzero fret shifts, one line per string and one or two unique outer slurs
Partial sliding chords, cross-system slides, grace slides and other playing techniques remain incomplete
MIDI timing comparison is not an audible or device playback test
